decision: Adopt an explicit 4-tier model: Tier 0 inventory (filesystem/package/config — every repo), Tier 1 heuristic (regex import patterns — inferred/low unless resolved), Tier 2 parser-backed (Python AST + TS/JS today; Swift/Kotlin later), Tier 3 build/runtime (package manager/Gradle/Xcode/LSP/traces — reserved). Confidence rises with tier; the registry tags each extractor with its tier.
rationale: Operator framing 2026-06-09: language-agnostic discovery with honest tiers, not pretend native understanding of every stack.

decision: C0 is a precursor to Plan D, not a UI change. C0 establishes detector + registry + tier-0/1 baseline + tiered coverage; Plan D renders coverage/diff honestly; Plan C+ adds tier-2 per-language parsers incrementally. C0 ships no UI beyond the existing coverage display.
rationale: Operator: add C0 before broad Plan D polish; keep scope to the substrate so each layer stays auditable.

decision: C0 generalizes the existing evidence contract (architecture_contract: source_kind/evidence_basis/confidence/missing_extractor + compute_coverage) rather than replacing it. The Python import crawler + JS import crawler become registered tier-2 extractors; the new tier-0/tier-1 baseline + registry sit under build_view_state alongside them.
rationale: Don't fork the reconciler — C0 is the language-agnostic substrate the Python+JS-centric pieces already partially implement.

decision: Unsupported languages MUST still produce a tier-0 file/config graph with an explicit low-confidence dependency note ('Dependency confidence is low. No <lang> extractor installed.'), never an empty surface and never a confident-looking fake graph. Tier 3 (runtime/build) is declared not_found until a later plan collects it.
rationale: Render-truth generalized to architecture: show what's provable for any repo, be loud about what isn't.

decision: The REPAIRED pre-impl loop ran on this fresh plan and REFUSED the lock with 3 blocking sufficiency findings (high empty-repo tier-0 guarantee; medium project-add wiring not proven together; medium undefined covered-per-evidence-type semantics) generated from a live Codex call — the exact path that crashed pre-fix, now working. Addressed all 3 by tightening F003/F004/F005 acceptance (non-empty tier-0 for empty repo; explicit covered/high parser vs partial/low heuristic semantics; real project-add/build_view_state integration proof). No override used — the gate's findings were legitimate and sharpened the plan.
rationale: First demonstration of the fixed governance loop catching real pre-impl gaps before implementation; addressing > overriding.

decision: Re-locked through the REPAIRED governance loop (PR #32, sufficiency-findings regen fix merged to main f5c6dae). The lock correctly REGENERATED fresh findings instead of reusing the stale committed file ('existing sufficiency findings predate input-fingerprinting — regenerating'), and the prior 3 findings did NOT recur (tightening genuinely addressed empty-repo tier-0, project-add wiring, covered/high semantics). Two NEW legitimate medium findings surfaced: (1) acceptance pins pure/deterministic/bounded for detector+baseline but NOT registry purity/determinism nor detector bounded-traversal on large repos; (2) no explicit truncation/limit-hit signal when a repo exceeds scan caps — a bounded baseline could omit nodes/edges while appearing complete (render-truth gap). Do NOT override — tighten F001/F002 (registry purity+determinism, detector bounded traversal) and F003/F004 (truncation/limit-hit signal in graph + coverage) then re-lock.
rationale: End-to-end validation that the repaired loop regenerates fresh findings on plan edit; the 2 new findings are real and in keeping with C0's own honesty goals.

decision: Tightened acceptance vs the 2 fresh sufficiency findings the repaired loop surfaced (D006). Finding 1 (purity/determinism/bounded): F001 now requires the detector's traversal to be BOUNDED on large repos via a deterministic scan cap with a recorded truncation signal; F002 now requires registry resolution to be PURE + DETERMINISTIC (same profile -> same result, no fs/network). Finding 2 (truncation/limit-hit signal): F003 graph emits an explicit scan_truncated marker when the bounded scan hits its cap (never presents a partial graph as complete); F004 coverage block surfaces that signal so a capped scan never reads as covered; F005 adds an over-cap fixture asserting both. Introduced vocabulary: scan_truncated. No override used — addressing the findings, sharpening the plan.
rationale: Operator-narrowed C0 path: tighten the 2 D006 findings, then re-lock through the repaired gate. Honest render-truth: a bounded scan must announce its own incompleteness.

decision: Second re-lock through the repaired gate: the 2 D006 findings CLEARED (purity/determinism/bounded + truncation signal — D007 tightening worked, confirmed by regeneration not recurring them), and 4 NEW deeper findings surfaced: (1 HIGH integration_gap) F005's 5 fixtures (py/js-ts/swift-kotlin/empty/truncated) not locked to the real build_view_state operator path — can pass via low-level baseline tests; (2 HIGH coverage_gap) detector promises build/test/app-framework/infra/config evidence classes but the coverage block enumerates only filesystem/package_manifest/imports/runtime/adr — detected classes could be invisible or folded into filesystem; (3 MED wiring_gap) plan doesn't protect the render-truth path from filtering out low-confidence/unresolved edges, filesystem/config nodes, or scan_truncated before the operator sees them; (4 MED coverage_gap) deterministic limited/partial/covered rollup rules not locked. The gate is progressively sharpening the plan each round (valuable) but each round costs a paid sufficiency call. PAUSED for operator decision on the next round vs accept-current.
rationale: Honest checkpoint: the repaired loop keeps surfacing real, deeper gaps; addressing > overriding, but the tighten->re-lock cadence is paid and should be operator-paced, not auto-spiraled.

decision: Tightened the plan against all 4 D008 findings, anchored on the coverage-taxonomy design (finding 2, done FIRST per operator direction): the per-evidence-type map is keyed by ONE taxonomy unified with the architecture contract's existing source_kind enum — filesystem (NEW source_kind for tier-0 inventory), code (imports), manifest, build, test, config, infra, doc, adr, runtime; external/unknown stay endpoint classifications outside coverage. Every ProjectProfile detection class (now a CLOSED list on F001) maps deterministically into exactly one evidence_type via a single exported mapping table (languages->code, package_managers->manifest, build_systems->build, test_frameworks->test, app_frameworks->manifest, infra->infra, config->config, docs_adr->doc/adr) with a tested TOTALITY guarantee so no detected class is invisible or folded into filesystem. Around that anchor: (finding 4) pinned the deterministic rollup lattice — limited when no detected language has tier-2 imports coverage (empty repo included); covered only when every detected language is parser-backed AND no detected evidence class is missing_extractor/error AND not scan_truncated; partial otherwise; runtime (tier-3 reserved) and undetected classes report not_found WITHOUT demoting; scan_truncated demotes covered->partial; each rule pinned by a named test case. (finding 1) F005 now drives EVERY fixture (py/js-ts/swift-kotlin/empty/truncated) through the real project-registration + build_view_state operator path with assertions on the final view-state payload; low-level tests supplement but never satisfy. (finding 3) F003/F004 now assert render-truth PASSTHROUGH against the final rendered payload: low-confidence/unresolved tier-1 edges, tier-0 filesystem/config nodes, and scan_truncated survive the render gate unchanged. No override used.
rationale: Operator-paced round 3 (taxonomy-first shape specified 2026-06-09): resolve the model-contract issue deliberately offline, tighten the rest around it, then spend ONE re-lock. Unifying on source_kind avoids a third parallel vocabulary (extractor evidence_kind vs source_kind vs coverage evidence_type) — the exact ambiguity the finding flagged.
